What Is Community Service?

Community service is volunteer work you do to help your school or community — no pay, just giving your time. It\'s not required at OBHS, but colleges and scholarships often look for it, and it\'s a genuinely good way to build skills and give back.

How It Works
Who can join?
Rising seniors (current Class of 2027) are eligible to apply for all five committees.
How often do we meet?
Once a month during a scheduled period with Student Life staff.
What's the commitment?
Attend monthly meetings, work on committee projects, and present to administration when needed.
What do I get?
Leadership experience, a line on college applications, and the chance to actually change things at OBHS.
What Is Battle of the Classes?

Battle of the Classes is one of the most exciting traditions at OBHS — a competition where each grade goes head-to-head in athletic events and performs a dance. Whether you're competing or cheering,everyone plays a role.

Sign-ups reopen in spring 2027
When sign-ups open, you'll pay your Class Advisor $10 to lock in your spot. This covers your t-shirt, which is also your ticket to the event. The photos below are from last year's Battle of the Classes.

OBHS Student Life

Start a New Club

Something New at OBHS

Students come to you first when they want to start a club — here's what to know before you say yes, so you can set them up for a smooth approval instead of a stalled one.

Requirements to Start a Club
  • A faculty advisor willing to commit to the role (that's you)
  • A core group of interested students — a handful of names to start, not the whole roster on day one
  • A clear purpose or mission that doesn't significantly overlap with an existing club
  • A realistic plan for regular meetings for the rest of the year
The Approval Process
  • Student(s) submit a New Club application through the Club Hub (button below)
  • Student Life reviews it for duplication, feasibility, and advisor sign-off
  • Once approved, the club is added to the live Club Directory — searchable, with its own flyer-ready listing
  • You're notified and can schedule your first meeting right away
Timing

Clubs meant to run the full school year are best submitted early in the fall. A club can still be approved later in the year, but with less time to meet and less certainty it'll return the following September.

Submit Your Club Request

Old Bridge High School

Field Trip Submission Instructions

Submission Deadline

All field trip requests must be submitted six (6) weeks in advance of the trip date.

Before Submitting, Make Sure You Include
  • Completed Field Trip Authorization Form
  • Tentative student roster with each student's full name, ID number, and grade
  • All staff members attending the trip are listed
  • Substitute/coverage needs are indicated, if applicable
  • Supervisor/Director signature has been obtained
Day of the Trip
  • Updated/final student roster goes to Maria DelPino, the nurse, and Marilyn Zino (attendance)
  • Roster includes: student full name, student ID number, and grade
  • Roster must reflect actual attendance for that day
  • Students must report to first period for attendance before departing for the trip

Incomplete field trip requests will be returned and could delay approval.

Old Bridge High School

Deposits & Check Requests

Making a Deposit
  1. Complete the approved deposit form
  2. When submitting cash, make sure it's all facing the same direction
  3. When submitting checks, write each one individually on the form — if submitting more than 10 checks, attach a separate list. All checks must be made out to Old Bridge High School
  4. All change will be counted by the change machine in Amboy
Requesting a Check
  1. Complete the check request form — attach all invoices and/or receipts
  2. Submit the request to Lori Obdyke via mailbox
  3. Once administration approves the request, the check will be written and submitted for signatures
  4. Please allow 2–3 days for this process

Deposit slips and check request forms can be found in the main office, in the drawer closest to the mailboxes. Any questions, don't hesitate to ask — Lori Obdyke.

Old Bridge Public Schools

Physical Information

Trying Out for a Fall Sport?

Every athlete — middle school or high school — needs a cleared physical on file before tryouts. There are no exceptions. Physicals are valid for 365 days from the date the physician performs the exam.

Your Physical Must Not Expire Before
August 10, 2026 Football, Cheerleading, Dance, Tennis
August 17, 2026 Cross Country, Field Hockey, Gymnastics, Soccer, Volleyball
September 1, 2026 All Fall Middle School Sports
What You Need to Do
  • Physicals for fall sports are due by July 15, 2026 if not already submitted
  • Drop off physicals at Old Bridge High School — 4209 Route 516, Matawan, NJ 07747, Door 0
  • Sign up for your fall sport through the parent portal, and review all athletic forms
  • Parents are responsible for knowing the status of their child's physical — check the parent portal directly
  • Athletic Trainers contact students through Microsoft Teams if a physical is expired or a Health History update is needed, 2–3 weeks before the season starts
